title: Aureline M5 output-trust-banner component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the output_trust_banner family binds inside the frozen M5 notebook-kernel-output component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-notebook-kernel-output-component-matrix.schema.json). An output trust banner names an output's trust class and its freshness so a banner never presents stale output as live and never hides its raw / sanitized / active trust class behind a hover-only affordance. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
